tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Value-Top GS40UW All-in-One PC is a modern, space-saving desktop solution designed for office, education, and home computing. Powered by the efficient Intel® Celeron® N95 processor, this AIO PC delivers smooth performance for daily tasks such as web browsing, office applications, online classes, and multimedia use.


Featuring a 23.8-inch Full HD display, the GS40UW provides sharp visuals and a comfortable viewing experience. Its all-in-one design integrates the CPU behind the screen, reducing cable clutter and making it ideal for workstations, reception desks, and classrooms.


Key Features


  • Intel® Celeron® N95 processor
  • 23.8-inch Full HD (1920×1080) display
  • Slim and space-saving all-in-one design
  • Smooth performance for office and home use
  • Energy-efficient and quiet operation
  • Ideal for business, education, and personal computing
